title: SEO
sub: How the shop is found on Google: which pages search engines may list and the address each page gives as its own.

kpi.openSub: listed on the shop's own address only
kpi.noPrimarySub: set at go-live; until then pages name the preview address
kpi.bengaliSub: only ready pages are listed in Bengali

safe.title: The preview is never listed.
safe.text: Search engines see the shop only on its own address, and only after you open it below. Customers' pages (bag, checkout, account, orders) are never listed.

indexing.title: Search engines
indexing.desc: English pages live at /, Bengali at /bn with the same link words. Each page names itself, in its own language, as its address.
indexing.engines: Let search engines list the shop
indexing.enginesHint: Off by default. Turn it on on go-live day, after the shop's own address is set.
indexing.pagesHint: Once the shop is open. A filtered list, a preview or a page that is not on sale is never listed.
indexing.xDefaultHint: Which page a searcher who reads neither English nor Bengali is sent to.
indexing.readOnly: You can see these settings. Changing them needs the "Change the SEO settings" permission.

errors.STALE: Someone else changed these settings. The page shows the new values; check them and save again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change the SEO settings.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Try again.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
errors.AI_OFF: AI drafts are off. Turn on AI for the shop and "Offer AI drafts" first.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI writer could not be reached. Try again later.
errors.DECIDED: Someone already decided this draft. The list shows what is still waiting.
errors.LIVE_PAGE: That old link is a page the shop has (a live product or category). Change the page's own link instead.
errors.OWN_PAGE: That address is the shop's own page (home, bag, checkout, account, search, the sets) and can never forward.
errors.SELF: A link cannot forward to itself.
errors.TOO_MANY: The list is too long: at most {fields} lines at a time.

titles.title: Search titles and descriptions
titles.desc: The title and short description Google shows for each kind of page. Words in {braces} are filled in from the page itself. A page's own text always comes first.
titles.kindHint: A page's own text (typed in for it, or an AI draft someone accepted) comes before this template. An empty description leaves the page's own words, or none.
titles.productHint: Each product's own title and description (on its product page) come before these. Products use more words, such as the brand, the colours and the price.

sample.name: Classic Polo
sample.intro: Soft cotton polos for every day.

titles.emptyTitle: Empty: the page keeps its plain title.
titles.emptyDescription: Empty: the page's own words, or no description.

ai.title: AI drafts
ai.desc: The AI can write a title and description for products and categories that have none of their own, from the page's own facts. Nothing goes on a page until you accept it.
ai.shopOff: AI is off for the whole shop (Settings › AI). Drafts can be made only after it is turned on there.
ai.batchMax: At most this many pages per press
ai.missing: Without their own text: {products} product pages, {categories} category pages (each language counts).
ai.draft: Draft for pages without their own text
ai.more: {n} more drafts are waiting; they show here as these are decided.

sd.title: Data for search engines
sd.desc: What Google reads beside each page, always from what the page itself shows (structured data).

part.itemList: The list of products on a category page, and of the pairs on a combo rule's page
part.product: A product with its price and stock
part.wasPrice: The struck price, where the page shows one
part.combo: A set with its set price and stock
part.organization: The shop itself on the home page (name, logo, contact, social pages)
part.website: The website's name on the home page
part.reviews: A product's star rating and reviews, from real approved reviews only
part.faq: Questions and answers (FAQ) — the product's answered questions, a collection page's questions and the FAQ page; optional, Google shows no FAQ result for it since 7 May 2026
part.article: Journal articles — headline, description, dates, language, topic and an honest byline (an AI author is sent as the shop, never as a person); optional
part.returns: A product's return policy — the exchange window its promise row says (a size swap only, or returns too), for the country set on the Merchant Center feed; optional
part.shipping: A product's free delivery — only when its page promises free delivery for it bought alone (its own free delivery, or every price over the free-delivery amount); a charge that depends on the area is never sent; optional
part.variants: A product's colours and sizes as variants (Google's variant markup) — one entry per colour and size the page sells, with its SKU, photo, price, stock and the address that opens it; optional

sd.never: A star rating goes only from real approved reviews, exactly as the product page shows them (the average, the count and the review cards); a product with none sends none. Never a price the page does not show.

rd.title: Redirects & 404
rd.sub: Old links send people to the right page with a permanent redirect. The WordPress map switches on at go-live.

safe.title: Nothing is deleted.
safe.text: A redirect is only switched off. An old link never takes over the home page, the bag, the checkout or a page the shop has.

list.title: Old links that forward
list.desc: Renamed products and categories, links typed in by hand, combos with their colours in another order and the WordPress map.
list.emptyBody: A redirect is made when a product or category gets a new link, or when you add one here.
list.more: Showing the first {n}. Search to find others.

add.title: Add a redirect
add.desc: An old address and the page it should open. Pointing at an old link follows it to its end.
add.toHint: The new page's address on this shop, starting with /.

imp.title: Import a list of old links
imp.desc: Paste or choose a file: one line per link, the old address then the new one. First press Check; only the lines that pass are written. Imported links are kept at least {months} months.
imp.textHint: Comma, semicolon or tab between the two. A full address is cut to its path. A heading line and lines starting with # are skipped.

nf.title: 404 report
nf.desc: Links people opened that have no page. Send each to the right page, or set it aside.

wp.title: WordPress 301 map
wp.desc: {n} old shop links are in the map.
wp.liveHint: Off by default. Turn it on on go-live day, when the main domain points at this shop; then every old link forwards to its new page.

opt.recordHint: On by default. Counts every shop address that has no page.
opt.percent: Suggest a page from this match (%)
opt.hashHint: A shop page opened with a link to the approved demo (…/#/p/…, #/c/…) moves on to its live page at once.

up.title: Pages that stay
up.desc: A product or collection that was on the shop never shows "page not found". Its page stays, honestly says it cannot be bought now, and sends people on.
up.alternatives: "Available now" on pages that cannot be bought
up.alternativesHint: A sold-out, taken-off or archived product page shows products from its category that can be bought now.
up.max: How many products the row shows
up.soldOutIndexedHint: The page keeps its place in Google until the restock; then it is a normal page again by itself.
up.retiredIndexed: Taken-off and archived pages stay in search
up.retiredIndexedHint: Also the resting page of an archived collection. Off: such pages ask search engines not to list them; their links are still followed.
up.retiredCategoryPage: Archived collections keep a resting page
up.retiredCategoryPageHint: A collection archived after it had products on the shop shows a short page with the live collections. A hidden collection is your choice and stays closed. Off: "page not found" as before.

cs.title: Collection pages
cs.sub: What search engines read for each collection and sub-collection, and the few filtered pages they may list.

rule.title: Only the pages that earn visits.
rule.text: A filtered page (a size, a colour, a price) normally points to its clean collection page, so Google does not see hundreds of near-copies. Name only the filtered pages people really search for.

texts.title: Words for search engines
texts.desc: Pick a collection or sub-collection and write its own search title, search line, heading and the text under its products, in both languages. An empty field uses the shop's template.
texts.none: There are no collections yet. Add them in Catalogue › Categories first.

f.title: Search title
f.titleHint: Shown as the blue line on Google. Up to {n} characters.
f.metaHint: The grey line under the title on Google. Up to {n} characters.
f.heading: Page heading
f.headingHint: The heading above the text at the bottom of the collection page. Up to {n} characters.
f.textHint: A short text at the bottom of the page, about the collection. Up to {n} characters.

cs.half: Write "{field}" in both languages, or leave it empty in both.

fp.title: Filter pages in search engines
fp.desc: The few filtered pages that may appear on Google as pages of their own, such as navy polos or polos in XL. Every other filter combination points to the clean collection page.
fp.enabledHint: Off: every filtered page points to its collection page.
fp.min: Fewest styles on a listed page
fp.minHint: A named page with fewer styles than this is not listed (a thin page hurts the shop). Default: {v}.
fp.valueHint: Exactly as it shows in the page address, capitals too, for example navy, XL or slim.
fp.addHint: Then press Save. The page name becomes its title and heading.
fp.twin: This collection already has a page for this filter and value.
fp.full: The list is full. Raise "Most named pages" or remove a page first.

sm.title: Sitemaps
sm.desc: The list of the shop's pages that search engines read: one file per kind, made from the catalogue by itself. It holds only pages that may be listed.
sm.noAddress: the shop has no address yet
sm.twins: A page whose Bengali version is marked ready counts twice: English and Bengali.
sm.madeNow: The sitemaps were made again from the catalogue.

f.cacheMinutesHint: A new product shows within this time. Default: {v} ({min} to {max}).
f.perFileHint: A longer list is split into more files. Default: {v} ({min} to {max}).

rb.title: Robots and AI assistants
rb.desc: What /robots.txt tells the robots that read the shop: search engines and AI assistants.
rb.ai: AI assistants may read the shop
rb.aiHint: On: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI can read the shop and name it in their answers. Off: the robots listed below are kept out.
rb.bots: AI robots kept out when the switch is off
rb.botsHint: One name per line, at most {n}. Shipped with: {v}.
rb.pathsHint: One path per line, each starting with /, at most {n}. The admin and a customer's own pages are always kept out.
rb.nowHint: On the shop's own address. While the shop is closed to search engines every robot is kept out.

ap.title: Summary for AI assistants
ap.desc: /llms.txt: a short file AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) read to learn what the shop is — its name, your summary, the collections, the shop rules pages and the contact details, all from what the shop already shows.
ap.onHint: On: AI assistants can read the summary. Off: the address says "not found".
ap.summaryHint: One short paragraph in your own words, such as what you sell and for whom; at most {n} letters ({used} now). Empty: left out, nothing is made up.
ap.closed: The file answers only while the shop is open to search engines on its own address (Indexing, above).

il.title: Links between pages
il.desc: Plain links between the shop's own pages, which shoppers and search engines both follow.
il.collectionsHint: On: under each collection page, links to its sub-collections or sister collections, then the other main collections (only shown ones with styles).
il.also: Product pages already link related products ("Wear it with", "You may also like"). Links to journal articles come with the journal.

at.title: Photo descriptions
at.desc: The words search engines and screen readers get for each product photo (alt text). The shop writes them from the product's name, the photo's colour and the kind of photo.
at.missingHint: "Write them now" writes each one. A description typed in Media is never changed.
at.none: Every product photo has a description.
at.bengali: The English one goes live at once. A Bengali page builds its own from the Bengali words of the dictionary, so nothing is written in Bengali.
at.auto: Write a description as each photo is added
at.autoHint: On: a photo added to a product gets its description at once, if it has none.
at.maxHint: Default {v} ({min} to {max}). A longer one is cut at a whole word.

se.title: Search Console and Bing
se.desc: Prove to Google and Bing that the shop is yours, then hand them the sitemap, so they read the shop's pages sooner.
se.step1: In Google Search Console (and Bing Webmaster Tools) add the property for the shop's address: {site}. Choose "HTML tag".
se.step2: Paste the tag (or only its code) below and press Save. Every shop page then carries it.
se.step3: Back in Search Console and Bing, press "Verify".
se.step4: Connect each in Keys & connections and press "Send the sitemap" here, or add {sitemap} under Sitemaps there yourself.
se.codesHint: Paste the whole tag or only its code; one per line, at most {n}. Empty as shipped.
se.noTags: No code yet: the pages carry nothing.
se.practice: Not connected: add the key in Keys & connections
se.sendHint: Each connected engine gets the sitemap for the shop's property. An engine without a key sends nothing.

out.noProperty: the account has no property for the shop's address; add and verify it first
out.unreachable: did not answer; try again later

blocked.noDomain: The shop has no domain of its own yet; nothing was sent.
blocked.sitemapsOff: Sitemaps are off (Sitemaps card); nothing was sent.

vt.title: Real visitors' speed
vt.desc: How fast the shop really loads for its visitors (Core Web Vitals), the number Google ranks by, against the targets. Kept only as daily counts, never who visited.
vt.span: The 75th percentile of the last {days} days ({n} page loads): three visits in four were this fast or faster.
vt.noReadings: No reading yet in the last {days} days. Pages report once visitors open them.
vt.testReadings: {n} readings came from the shop's own test browsers (the check, the saved journeys, the monthly lab). They are only counted here, never in the figures above.
vt.byKind: LCP on a phone by page:
vt.labMiss: {when}: a page missed a target (in red). {profile}
vt.noLab: Not run yet. It runs by itself on the 2nd of each month, on the server, against the preview address.
vt.collectHint: On: each page reports its speed as it loads. Nothing about the visitor is kept.

f.shareHint: Default {v} ({min} to {max}). Fewer is enough on a busy shop.
f.daysHint: Default {v} ({min} to {max}). Google reads the last 28 days.

t.categoryKb: Target: category page weight (KB, monthly check)
t.adminMs: Target: admin page load (ms, monthly check)

hl.title: Language pairs (hreflang)
hl.desc: A page whose Bengali twin is ready names both languages in its head, so Google shows English searchers the English page and Bengali searchers the Bengali one. A page with no ready twin names none.
hl.off: Bengali is off, so no page names a Bengali twin.
hl.noneReady: No page is marked Bengali-ready yet, so no page names a pair.
hl.count: {n} of {m} Bengali-ready pages name their pair.
hl.tags: What a page with a pair carries
hl.tagsHint: In the head of both twins, the same three lines; x-default sends any other language to the English page.
hl.tagsHintNoDefault: In the head of both twins, the same lines; no x-default (Search engines › More options › Searchers in other languages).
hl.hidden: No: this kind of page is hidden from search engines
hl.inSitemaps: Also name the pairs in the sitemaps
hl.inSitemapsHint: Off: the pairs are only in each page's head, one method, as Google advises. On: the sitemaps carry the same pairs too.

sh.title: SEO health
sh.sub: What is missing, page by page: product and collection pages search engines can't fully read yet, and where each one is fixed.

kpi.pagesFoot: of {products} published products and {collections} shown collections
kpi.bengaliFoot: Coverage and the pages marked ready

issue.noSearchLine: No search line of its own

sh.none: Nothing missing: every published product and shown collection has its words and photos.
sh.more: And {n} more: pick one kind above to see them.
sh.deploy: Every deploy also checks the built pages themselves: each language pair is complete and named back, the canonical is in the page's own language, and no link is a "#" stand-in.

og.title: Organic report
og.sub: How much of the shop's Sales comes from search engines, YouTube and AI assistants instead of ads, and how the shop does in Google's and Bing's results.
og.span: Last {days} days: {from} – {to}. Sales = delivered orders, on their delivered day.

kpi.aiFootOrders: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the others
kpi.clicksNone: Connect Search Console or Bing to see them

row.notKnown: Not known (typed in, saved or from an app)

og.none: No organic order in these days yet.
og.notKnownNote: "Not known": the visitor typed the address, used a bookmark or came from an app that sends no address. Such orders still count as organic because no ad brought them.
og.keepOn: Visits from the sites in the list below are remembered even without a tag, the same way and for as long as an ad click, but never in place of an ad click already remembered.
og.keepOff: Untagged visits from search engines and AI assistants are not remembered now (switched off below), so most such orders show as "Not known". ChatGPT's links still say so themselves.
og.noQueries: No search in these days yet.

status.practice: Not connected: add the key in Keys & connections, then the clicks, positions and top searches show here.
status.noDomain: The shop has no domain of its own yet, so there is nothing to look up.
status.noProperty: Connected, but the account has no property for the shop's own address. Add it in the engine and verify it (Website › SEO › Search Console and Bing).
status.unreachable: The engine did not answer just now. Open the page again later.

set.title: Report settings
set.desc: How many days the report covers, your target, and which sites count as search engines, video sites and AI assistants.
set.targetPct: Target share of Sales from organic (%)
set.keep: Remember untagged visits from these sites
set.keepHint: A plain Google result or an AI answer carries no tag; with this on, the site it came from is remembered until the order, but never in place of an ad click already remembered.
set.sourcesHint: One site per line: the name, a colon, then the addresses that name it, separated by commas (a full address such as perplexity.ai, or one word of it such as google). AI assistants are checked first, then video, then search engines.
set.bad: {box}: line {lines} needs a name, a colon and at least one address.
